content.text: {"id": "mm6936a6", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "were estimated at 34.0, 17.5, and 16.5 per 10,000"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "is a 33% increase since 2006"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the overall prevalence was 34.0 per 10,000 live births"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "the overall prevalence was 34.0 per 10,000 live births"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence estimates for NBS disorders among infants born during 2015–2017 were compared with estimates among infants born in 2006."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This first national report based on reported cases from all 50 states estimates"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence estimates for NBS disorders among infants born during 2015–2017 were compared with estimates among infants born in 2006."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "For each disorder, denominator data included only births during months for which universal screening was available in the state"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "To estimate annual case counts, the 2015–2017 prevalence rates calculated empirically in this assessment were applied to the total U.S. birth cohort for 2018."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence estimates for NBS disorders among infants born during 2015–2017 were compared with estimates among infants born in 2006."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "The number of births includes only births that occurred during 2015–2017 that each state conducted screening for the disorder"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Prevalence based on hearing loss cases reported by 45 states and DC in 2006 to CDC’s Hearing Screening and Follow-up Survey."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types"]}
